The keyed `home:` resolves to `/work/acme-api-worktrees/<name>`, matching `$WORKTREE` with `NAME=rate-limit`. No `destroy:` is configured.

Run in order, proceeding only after each command succeeds:

```bash
git -C "/work/acme-api" worktree remove "/work/acme-api-worktrees/rate-limit" &&
git -C "/work/acme-api" worktree prune &&
git -C "/work/acme-api" branch -D "rate-limit"
```
